settings.text: Temi! Hi! I'm about to make a payment—
settings.direction: Panicked and breathless, speaking very fast with desperate fake cheer, voice rising, cut off at the end.
settings.instruct: A man in his late thirties with a quick, warm, slightly husky American baritone; a charming, fast-talking space courier who sells for a living. Panicked and breathless, speaking very fast with desperate fake cheer, voice rising, cut off at the end.

settings.text: Temi! Hi! I'm about to make a payment—
settings.direction: Frantic, talking over someone at top speed, high-pitched nervous excitement.

settings.text: She is in Lagos. You are arguing with the past.
settings.direction: Completely deadpan and flat, bone-dry, unhurried and precise, no emotion at all.
settings.instruct: A crisp, precise British male voice belonging to a small, fussy ship's computer; mid-pitched, clipped consonants, very dry and literal. Completely deadpan and flat, bone-dry, unhurried and precise, no emotion at all.

settings.text: Your record isn't late, Captain. It's blank.
settings.direction: A cool, cutting put-down, calm and slightly amused, the last word low and final.
settings.instruct: A woman in her mid-thirties with a low, cool, dry voice and a light Bengali Indian-English accent; exact, composed, quietly amused. A cool, cutting put-down, calm and slightly amused, the last word low and final.

settings.direction: Shouting at full volume across a distance, urgent, out of breath, adrenaline.

settings.text: Read it to me. Slowly. I want to enjoy my name.
settings.direction: Relaxed and savouring the moment, with a short amused laugh before the last sentence, grinning.

settings.text: Read it to me. Slowly. Ha! I want to enjoy my name.
settings.direction: Chuckling, delighted and smug, laughing as he speaks.

settings.text: You gave up your job for us.
settings.direction: Quiet, warm and sincere, slightly moved and touched, slower than usual.

settings.text: Good morning! This is Temi in Recoveries. Your vessel is being recovered.
settings.direction: Very bright, chirpy and sing-song, professional call-centre cheer, smiling.
